meta..validate: newData.hasChildren(['version', 'status', 'hostUid', 'teamSize', 'maxPlayers']) && newData.child('status').val().matches(/^(lobby|playing|ended)$/) && newData.child('teamSize').isNumber() && newData.child('teamSize').val() >= 1 && newData.child('teamSize').val() <= 3 && newData.child('maxPlayers').val() == newData.child('teamSize').val() * 2

$uid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['uid', 'name', 'raceId', 'teamId', 'slot', 'color', 'connected']) && newData.child('uid').val() == auth.uid && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().length <= 24 && newData.child('raceId').isNumber() && newData.child('raceId').val() >= 1 && newData.child('raceId').val() <= 4 && newData.child('teamId').isNumber() && newData.child('teamId').val() >= 1 && newData.child('teamId').val() <= 2 && newData.child('slot').isNumber() && newData.child('slot').val() >= 1 && newData.child('slot').val() <= 6

$slot..write: auth != null && root.child('frontieres/rooms').child($roomCode).child('meta/status').val() == 'lobby' && ((!data.exists() && newData.val() == auth.uid) || data.val() == auth.uid)
